fix.notes: Pure one-line fix mirroring an identical pattern already present in the sibling view. No template or JS changes needed; `hide_perfect_runs` is already consumed by the shared deck table template.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The single-archetype tournament-only view (`/archetypes/{id}/tournament/`) was missing `self.hide_perfect_runs = tournament_only` in `decksite/views/archetype.py`. The sibling `Archetypes` list view (`archetypes.py:14`) already sets `self.tournament_only = self.hide_source = self.hide_perfect_runs = tournament_only`, which hides the 5-0s ("perfect runs") column from the deck table in tournament-only mode — but the single-archetype view omitted `hide_perfect_runs`, so the column was still shown.

## What changed

One-character change in `decksite/views/archetype.py` line 88: added `self.hide_perfect_runs =` to the existing chained assignment, mirroring the pattern already used in `archetypes.py`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped in 17.61s (full suite, with live MariaDB)

Fixes #11462
fix.pr_title: Drop 5-0s column from tournament-only archetype view (#11462)

evidence.detail: Sets `self.tournament_only = self.hide_source = tournament_only` but never sets `self.hide_perfect_runs`
The plural Archetypes view correctly sets `self.tournament_only = self.hide_source = self.hide_perfect_runs = tournament_only`; the singular Archetype view omits hide_perfect_runs
5–0s column is guarded by `{{^is_matchups}}{{^hide_perfect_runs}}` — it renders whenever hide_perfect_runs is falsy, which it always is on the tournament-only single-archetype page

One-line change, no template or JS changes needed.
